meteorite.description:
An object fallen from the sky. 
It seems to be stuck on the ground.
meteorite.tip:
Explore the world in search of meteorites. At night you can see their glow from afar. 
Extract them with the winch to earn Pebbles and upgrade your vehicle.

radar.name: Meteorite Radar
radar.description: The meteorite radar can help you find meteorites!
